name: Ectoplasmic Coating
body:
School abjuration; Level bard 2, magus 2, ranger 2, shaman 2, spiritualist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target touched armor
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell you tug a few drops of ectoplasm from the ethereal plane and smear it across a suit of armor. For the duration of this spell the armor gains the ghost touch property, the armor’s bonus also increases by +4 against critical confirmation rolls against incorporeal creatures.
